notes.title: Two new stages will be added, and an update is planned for the near future.
notes.content: [p]We have added two new stages. We have also added new characters and revised the game balance. The game's story has been improved, making it even more enjoyable. An update is planned for the near future, so please stay tuned.[/p]

notes.title: 9/16 update
notes.content: Added more stages and weapons. improved player mobility. And added 4 new achievements. We also reviewed the quality of each stage and the game balance.

notes.title: We will be updating Subenishiki in the near future with a major update.
notes.content:
Two new storytelling stages have been added. The new stage focuses on subenishiki's revenge. The battle takes place in the gravitational sphere of Mars, a favorable terrain for subenishiki that can fly. The subenishiki are challenged by the powerful weapons and maneuverability of the battle armor (player) dedicated to the gravitation sphere.
　Four new achievements have been added. We have also reviewed the quality of each stage, terrain, items, and game balance.
